## What We Did

Covered key introductory concepts of machine learning, built a basic predictive model.

## Key Concepts

Machine Learning: attempts to predict y given predictors x1, x2, ... , xk + err

most basic form: linear regression

models range in rigidness (interpretability) and flexibility
- linear regression is the most rigid
- neural nets are flexible but tough to explain and interpret

parametric model: assumes the relationship can be represented in a functional form
non-parametric model: assumes the data relationship is not easily explainable.

RMSE: Root Mean Squared Error; loss function, lower is generally better.
Overfitting: model has learned the noise; very non-generalizeable; very low RMSE

Train/Test Split - typically 80/20 OR use cross validation
K-fold Cross Validation: Split data into k equal chunks; train/test split where chunks "take turns" being the test chunk
